summary:
Iter49 validates the three new flows: (1) Backtester Market-vs-Limit toggle + limit->market fallback, (2) per-strategy auto-trade limit entry with wait-time (StrategyAutoTradeModal), (3) KI-Trader per-setup Maker-Policy (ai_engine + /api/ai/order-policy + AIOrderPolicyTable).

Backend focused suite (tests/test_order_type_compare_policy.py, tests/test_workbench_extended_and_local_bt.py, tests/test_grade_unify_and_dyn_basis.py, tests/test_dynamic_backup.py, -m 'not live'): 33/33 PASS.
Broader -m 'unit and not live' -k 'backtest or backtester or ai_engine or maker or bitunix_trade (+autopilot_history_import import dep)' with the pre-existing ignores (test_stale_regime_api / test_ai_fixes_iter2 / test_bugreport_fixes / test_iter_ai_supervisor_auto / test_nnfx / test_policy_promotion / test_regime_extras — all pre-existing collect/env issues): 125 passed, 2 skipped. Pre-existing failures still red at HEAD, exactly as flagged in review_request + iter47/48: tests/analysis_regression/test_ap01_dynamic_apply.py::TestTransitionScope (2 fails) — expects {'$in': ['meanrev','nnfx','trend']} but transition_close_query also includes the dynamic doc id 'd1'.

API (tests/test_iter49_order_policy_api.py, 2/2 PASS vs REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL):
- GET /api/ai/order-policy -> policy='setup', rows list, breakout.preset='market', pullback.preset='maker', every row has {setup,preset,mode,reason,source}.
- POST /api/ai/config with {maker_policy:'all', maker_setup_overrides:{breakout:'maker'}} persists (GET /api/ai/status.config), and the next /api/ai/order-policy row for 'breakout' has source='manual'. Reset to maker_policy='setup', overrides={} verified afterwards.

Real short backtest executed vs cloud: POST /api/backtest/run strategy_ids=['scalping_4_rules'], symbols=['BTCUSDT'], days=7, compare_order_types=true, limit_fallback_market=true, execution='cloud' finished (job be30e0c1ba9b, status=done). result.order_compare['scalping_4_rules'] contains both 'market' and 'limit' summaries with the full field set (trades, wins, losses, pnl, fees, max_drawdown, win_rate, fill_rate, limit_expired, limit_filled, limit_fallback), plus limit_fallback_market=true, choice='market', diff=0.0, why='gleichwertig (Unterschied unter Sicherheitsabstand) → Market (Ausführung sicher)'. (Scalping is strict on 7d BTCUSDT so trades=0 in both tracks — structure is wired correctly; non-zero trades would need a less selective strategy or longer window.)

Frontend (Chromium, 1920x1080, Admin/admin login via admin-lock-button):
- Backtester modal: bt-compare-orders unchecks by default; after clicking it, bt-limit-fallback appears and is checked. Labels 'Market vs. Limit vergleichen' and 'Limit-Fallback auf Market (wie Live)' render in German as expected.
- StrategyAutoTradeModal (strategy TrendFolge2, strategy-trade-toggle-custom_23a30b65): opened in PAPER mode (sat-mode-paper) so the full form renders; sat-entry-order current='market'; selecting value='limit' makes sat-limit-wait appear with value 45s. Reverted to 'market' and set sat-mode-off; closed via strategy-autotrade-close WITHOUT Speichern (no server write).
- KI-Trader panel (strategy-tab-ai_trader -> edit-strategy-params-btn -> ai-setup-toggle): ai-maker-mode-select='on', ai-maker-policy-select='setup' visible, ai-order-policy-toggle visible; clicking it renders ai-order-policy-table with 23 rows (trend_follow, trend_follow2, breakout, squeeze_breakout, mean_reversion, range_fade, liquidity_sweep, momentum_news, pullback, swing_trend, hedge, order_block, fvg_fill, htf_range, funding_fade, session_open, divergence, vwap_reclaim, fomc_event, cpi_event, nfp_event, ppi_event, pce_event) and 23 ai-op-override-* selects. Presets observed in UI match setup_order_policy: trend_follow/mean_reversion/range_fade/pullback/swing_trend -> Limit; breakout/squeeze_breakout/liquidity_sweep/momentum_news -> Market. Config left as found (maker_mode=on, maker_policy=setup, overrides={}).

minor.issue: Pre-existing failure (also flagged in review_request + iter47/48): transition_close_query now also includes the dynamic doc id 'd1' which the test asserts should be excluded. Not caused by iter49 changes.
Pre-existing collection error (os.environ['ADMIN_PASSWORD'] at import). Add .get() + pytest.skip to unblock broad -m unit runs.

minor.endpoint: collection: tests/test_ai_fixes_iter2.py, test_bugreport_fixes.py, test_iter_ai_supervisor_auto.py, test_nnfx.py, test_policy_promotion.py, test_regime_extras.py
minor.issue: Collection errors from `from tests.test_regime_engine import ...` — module missing. Pre-existing; broad runs rely on --ignore. Low priority.

action_items: Pre-existing: resolve TestTransitionScope drift (either include 'd1' in the test's expected $in list, or exclude dynamic doc ids from transition_close_query).

Pre-existing: guard tests/test_stale_regime_api.py against missing ADMIN_PASSWORD env (os.environ.get + pytest.skip) and recreate/fix the missing tests.test_regime_engine module so broad -m unit runs don't need the long --ignore list.
critical_code_review_comments: services/setup_order_policy.PRESETS cleanly maps all 23 setups to {maker,market} with reasons; the breakout family and liquidity_sweep/momentum_news/*_event setups default to Market, pullback/mean_reversion/range_fade/trend_follow(2)/swing_trend/order_block/fvg_fill/htf_range/divergence/vwap_reclaim default to Limit — matches the review_request intent. UI stats column ('L -/M -') correctly shows '-' when no history yet.

routers/ai.order-policy correctly folds (preset, override, auto-learned stats) into {mode, reason, source} per setup; source 'manual' is set only when maker_setup_overrides[setup] is set. Verified against live backend.

services/order_compare + services/backtester.simulate_pair: `limit_fallback_market` flag is threaded through to produce both the market and limit tracks with limit_expired / limit_filled / limit_fallback counters, and `choice`/`why` is picked with a safety margin. Structure is correct even with 0 trades.

StrategyAutoTradeModal: sat-entry-order is a <select> with 'market'|'limit', sat-limit-wait only renders when entry_order_type==='limit' (default wait 45s). Note (nitpick): the limit option is only reachable when the modal is in LIVE/PAPER (not AUS) — makes sense because AUS has no form, but reviewers should know this when writing additional e2e tests.

AIOrderPolicyTable renders only when maker_mode && maker_policy==='setup' — matches the ai-order-policy-toggle gating; override select writes directly through onOverride -> updateConfig({maker_setup_overrides:v}) with an immediate re-fetch of /api/ai/order-policy, so the 'manual' source badge appears right after the override is set (confirmed via backend test).

bitunix_trade._maker_entry uses per-setup limit_wait_sec from config and records attempts in by_setup — fill-rate learning path is wired. Live execution path NOT exercised (no Bitunix keys locally, per review_request).

success_rate.backend: 100% focused (33/33) + 100% new API (2/2); 125/125 broader (2 pre-existing failures + collection ignores unrelated to iter49)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of iter49 UI invariants (Backtester toggle, Auto-Trade Limit+wait, KI-Trader per-setup policy table)

seed_data_creation: None persisted. Backtest job be30e0c1ba9b created (completed, no live orders). AI config toggled to {maker_policy:'all', overrides:{breakout:'maker'}} during the API test then reset to {maker_policy:'setup', overrides:{}} (verified via /api/ai/status). AutoTrade modal paper-mode change was NEVER saved. No TEST_ data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To exercise sat-entry-order in the StrategyAutoTradeModal you MUST first click sat-mode-paper (or sat-mode-live) — in AUS mode the modal only shows the mode toggle and the form (incl. sat-entry-order) is not rendered. KI-Trader settings: strategy-tab-ai_trader -> edit-strategy-params-btn opens AITradingPanel on chat view; click ai-setup-toggle (bottom-right of the setups bar) to expand the config panel that contains ai-maker-mode-select and ai-order-policy-toggle. Known good non-dynamic built-in strategy id for /api/backtest/run with compare_order_types: 'scalping_4_rules' (returns order_compare but with 0 trades on 7d). For non-zero fills use a less selective strategy or longer window.
